title.en: An Act Amending Item (13) on Page 151, Subparagraph 38 for the Province of Negros Oriental, Under Paragraph c, Title a of Section One of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred and One
title.orig: An Act Amending Item (13) on Page 151, Subparagraph 38 for the Province of Negros Oriental, Under Paragraph c, Title a of Section One of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred and One

text.en:
Item (13) on page 151, subparagraph 38 for the Province of Negros Oriental, under paragraph c, Title A of Section one of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and one is amended to read as follows:
"(13) Pacuan Elementary School Building, La Libertad P10,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 19, 1960.
